bullets.text: 荷姆茲：10/14 一艘新加坡籍貨櫃輪遇襲後沉沒，襲船頻率為開戰以來最高；PortWatch 10/5–10/11 七日平均僅 4.1 艘/日（油輪 0.6 艘），較戰前均值 81.1 艘 −95%。
bullets.text_en: Hormuz: a Singapore-flagged container ship sank on 10/14 after being struck, with attacks at their highest since the war began; PortWatch shows a 7-day average (10/5–10/11) of just 4.1 transits/day (tankers 0.6), −95% vs the pre-war mean of 81.1.

bullets.text: 油輪：VLCC 10 月首週平均運價約 $665,000/日創紀錄；DHT 第四季約半數現貨航次已以平均 $509,100/日訂出。Brent 10/14 報 $105.68/桶，年增約 71%。
bullets.text_en: Tankers: the VLCC average rate in the first week of October hit a record ~$665,000/day; DHT has booked about half its Q4 spot days at an average $509,100/day. Brent stood at $105.68/bbl on 10/14, up ~71% y/y.

bullets.text: 美灣：9 個墨西哥灣主要港口油輪出口量 30 日均約 98.3 萬噸/日（至 10/9），為戰前均值 92.2 萬噸的 107%；亞洲煉油廠正尋求中東以外替代原油。
bullets.text_en: US Gulf: tanker exports from 9 major Gulf Coast ports averaged ~983 kt/day over 30 days (to 10/9), 107% of the pre-war mean of 922 kt; Asian refiners are seeking crude alternatives to the Middle East.
Containers & dry bulk: SCFI steady at 3,664 (10/9, +1.8) and Taiwan's three box carriers all posted higher September revenue; BDI 2,801 (10/13, −51), Capesize T/C $36,222/day (−$1,396).

bullets.text: 授信意涵：油輪船東現金流處於高峰，但 15 年船齡 VLCC 成交價達 $1.61 億，抵押品估值偏高，宜以正常化運價與船價壓力測試 LTV；中東航線船舶需確認戰爭險與船體險承保。
bullets.text_en: Credit implications: tanker owners' cash flow is at a peak, but a 15-year-old VLCC sold for $161m, so collateral values look stretched — stress-test LTV against normalised rates and values; confirm war-risk and hull cover for ships trading the Middle East.
